# A09-S236: Public debate

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Good news! Together Festival […] on Saturday will have Leder Lars in debate with Hørsholm’s mayor, Morten Slotved. Afterwards, the debate will be analyzed by our all-time favorite “political commentator” - Vincent Hendricks! ❤️

[…]

He had a good press strategy, so hopefully this will open the door to a broader debate in Denmark as well.

[…]
